title: Application and Petition of Fall River Gas Company pursuant to G.L. c. 164, §§ 8 and 14 for approval and authorization by the Department of Public Utilities (1) to issue and sell on a negotiated basis additional First Mortgage Bonds (or other long-term debt securities) in the aggregate principal amount of up to $6,000,000, to be sold at par; (2) to increase the Company's Common Stock $0.83-1/3 par value and to issue and sell not in excess of 391,000 shares of Common Stock, $0.83-1/3 par value, through an underwritten public offering, (3) for an exemption from the advertising and competitive bid requirements of G.L. c. 164, § 15,; and (4) for such other actions as may be deemed necessary or appropriate in connection with the foregoing.
